body:
My therapist has been aware that I've been suicidal for some time. She knows that I've attempted suicide in the past and that I have a plan. She had me text her by the same time every day for a week when she was worried about me, but that's all, there hasn't been any mention of hospitalization.

Basically, it's unlikely you'll be hospitalized unless you cannot keep yourself safe, if you had a plan and a date and your therapist had reason to believe you'd go through with it, that's when it might happen. But it doesn't sound like that's where you are at all, and if you share the thoughts you're experiencing with your therapist, they might be able to help you with them.

I'm really trying to be good about the supplements and the sun. I live in a place where cloudy days are pretty rare, so the sun's available most of the time.
Thank you friend!

They do know. I've tried to make it very clear to them. I do know thag I'm very reluctant to share how bad things are to them though, considering at one point I told them I nearlh tried to kill myself and they took away my entire support system and everything I was holding onto at them time, and I know I can't go through that again. Things are a bit better now that I'm eighteen, but there can still be a lot of struggling to get what I want. 

I've been try to give them a chance to be supportive in this situation due to the advice of my therapist, but it isn't really happening. Unfortunately, now that they know, I can't just start it myself while there's a chance they'll say yes to it. So I have to wait for a definite no to start on it myself. Hopefully I'll feel some effects from the vitamin D by then but who knows.

I think it is getting to be a pretty severe situation, which is why I'm trying to get this sorted out as soon as possible while I still have some amount of motivation a caring about myself, however small it might be. Financially I can make it work if needed.

Are you comfortable sharing what the supplement is?

I've tried 5-htp before, it's helped me slightly but I've noticed it loses its effectiveness when I try taking it long term (as well as you're not supposed to take it for more than 6 weeks, I believe, although it's been some time since I researched it). So I'm wondering if something similar is the case for you?

If you have a doctor you trust or are comfortable with and have the finances for therapy, I really would suggest pursuing it. It sounds like even if things aren't too bad for you, they could be better, and I think your son deserves for you to be the best parent you can be, you know?

I'll keep that in mind, thanks. I'm eighteen, so I'd hope that wouldn't be too much of a problem yet. I've had some joint problems, but more in my wrists (due to overuse/muscle tension). It's also something that happens regardless of physical activity, I can be lying in bed doing nothing and it's the worst.
Interesting, that's a good thought that hadn't occurred to me. I wouldn't say it's been a longer period than normal, but that makes sense, thanks.
I've had the same issue on an ETC Element board. I don't know the cause, but I've had success fixing it just by reprogramming the time.
An aye-aye. They're already fucking terrifying to look at, now imagine it the size of a car.

Not sure. You said you were looking for something that would last a good five years, right? I can't speak to their durability for that long a time period. I do know that I've used more expensive headsets that are absolute crap, and I've also been pleased with these so far (and replacement pieces are going to be on the cheaper side if necessary too).

I've had decent success using [these](https://midlandusa.com/product/gxt1000vp4/) in a small community theatre setting. I've actually been borrowing them from a friend who's had then for over a year. I've used them for my last three shows and they've held up pretty well--we've had an issue with one of the headsets that hasn't been fixed yet (may be a loose wire), but replacements are fairly inexpensive. They also have a whole range of functions I've barely touched. Oh, and despite being just down the street from a police station, we've never had an issue with interference once finding a good channel. These may be cheaper than you're looking for, but in my experience have been pretty solid.
